jobs.prompt:
Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 26f (logging-only visibility round). Read docs/state/silent-failures.md methodology (top) and the sections for the files below. Edit ONLY: tools/board-commands.mjs, tools/checks-from-ci.mjs, tools/lesson-store.mjs, tools/migration-gate.mjs, tools/preflight.mjs, tools/self-manage/lane-monitor.mjs, tools/swarm/warnings.mjs, tools/tunnel.mjs. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, or exports. No refactors or reformatting.

Line numbers below are CURRENT (verified against origin/swarm/train3). For each listed catch, bind the error and do exactly what the line says:
- SILENT-<CODE>: stay silent when error?.code === '<CODE>' (or the named class, e.g. SyntaxError); console.error anything else. Keep the same fallback value.
- LEAVE: make NO change to that catch at all.
- LOG-ALWAYS: console.error unconditionally, include the path/id named, keep the same fallback value.
- For `.catch(() => null)` / `.catch(() => '')` forms, keep returning the same value from inside the new handler.
- A close/cleanup inside an error path that rethrows: log the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT binding name; the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/board-commands.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/board-commands.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 33 `fs.realpath(rest[0]).catch(() => null)`: SILENT-ENOENT/ENOTDIR/EACCES — resolving a user-given folder path for `board projects add`; any failure already surfaces to the user as 'no such folder'.

### tools/checks-from-ci.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/checks-from-ci.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 236 `catch { /* no runtime scratch tree */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT — fs.stat on .swarm is just a best-effort probe for whether to add the swarm-ignore glob.

### tools/lesson-store.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/lesson-store.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 171 `await handle.close().catch(() => {})`: LOG-ALWAYS — closing the handle shouldn't fail; swallowing it hides handle/fs problems while the real error above is still rethrown.

### tools/migration-gate.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/migration-gate.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 328 `if ((await stat(join(root, dir))).isDirectory()) return dir`: SILENT-ENOENT — probing the known migration-tool directory names; most projects won't have a given one, log anything else.

### tools/preflight.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/preflight.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 79 `const info = await fs.stat(candidate); if (info.isFile())`: SILENT-ENOENT/EACCES/ENOTDIR — probing each PATH dir for the probe program; most won't have it, log anything else.

### tools/self-manage/lane-monitor.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/self-manage/lane-monitor.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 263 `timer = setIntervalFn(() => { tick().catch(() => {}); }, period)`: LOG-ALWAYS — tick() handles its own errors, so a rejection reaching this outer catch is unexpected; console.error it. Keep the interval running.

### tools/swarm/warnings.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/swarm/warnings.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 267 `binary = (await fs.readFile(...)).subarray(0,8000).includes(0)`: SILENT-ENOENT — a listed sibling file may vanish before it's read (race), so it's reported as plain text; log anything else since this only affects advisory warning text.

### tools/tunnel.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/tunnel.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 332 `try { deps.unlinkSync(plistPath) } catch { /* partial install */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT — best-effort cleanup of a just-written plist after launchctl bootstrap failed; the file may not have been created, log any other unlink failure before fail() reports only the launchctl error.

Do NOT touch any other catch. FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.

Then grep tests/ for each file's basename and run those tests with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test <files>; confirm green. Final summary: one line per flagged line.
